settings.enableGridRegions.name: Enable: Grid Regions
settings.enableGridRegions.hint: Make regions and spell templates measure with the scene grid's metric instead of true euclidean geometry, so they follow the core Grid Diagonals setting (e.g. Equidistant turns a 20 ft burst into an 8x8 square). Applies to hand-drawn regions and dnd5e activity templates, preview included. Requires a reload.
